issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement names the class 'Course' while the exercise text, template, and solution refer to the class as 'Lecture'. This identifier mismatch between the UML and the rest of the materials can confuse students about which class they should implement and test.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the class in the UML diagram from 'Course' to 'Lecture' (and update any UML references) so it matches the exercise text, template, and solution. Alternatively, explicitly note in the problem statement that the UML uses 'Course' to represent the 'Lecture' class to avoid confusion.
